item.title: Show HN: 3D-printed marble-maze-blind-box solved by tilt and sound [video]
item.summary: A solid cube with holes on the surface, hiding a tunnel maze inside. You can't see the tunnels, only the openings. Tilt it and listen for the marble to find its way from one opening to another. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49271308 Points: 1 # Comments: 1
